name: Royalton Luxury Resorts (ex-Sunwing special flown by WestJet)
description: Sunwing's scheme in Royalton Luxury Resorts' blue on 737 MAX 8 C-GMXB, flying for WestJet: the blue fin sweeping forward along the crown and down round the rear fuselage behind the aft door, as Sunwing's orange does, 'sunwing' in white up the fin with the small sun over its 'wing'; 'Royalton' in large navy script over the forward windows with 'Luxury Resorts' under it, 'royaltonresorts.com' small over the windows ahead of the wing, 'Experience All-In Luxury' in two lines behind the wing; blue engines with Royalton's white script R; the Canadian flag under the cockpit.

sources.title: C-GMXB B737-800, Sunwing (Royalton Luxury Resort), Cancun 03-08-26 (55171157737).jpg (CC BY 4.0, Duncan Kirk)
sources.note: C-GMXB (737 MAX 8; the file name says -800) right side climbing out of Cancún, 2026-03-08: flipped and fitted to the measured 737 MAX 8 shape (nose, fin tip, both doors); the titles' ends read off it, the blue's front edge (crown x 0.74, belly 0.89) as on Sunwing's scheme.

sources.title: Sunwing Airlines Boeing 737-8 MAX C-GMXB at Montréal-Trudeau International Airport.jpg (CC0, Wilfredor)
sources.note: C-GMXB right side from ahead at the gate, 2023-06-02: the same scheme under Sunwing.

sources.title: C-FMXG - Boeing 737 MAX 8 - Sunwing Airlines LIR 260225.jpg (CC BY 2.0, kitmasterbloke)
sources.note: Sunwing's standard (WJA/sunwing), whose geometry this special shares, measured on the left side.

paleBlue.name: the R monogram's light blue edge

areas.name: blue sweeping forward from the fin along the crown and down round the rear fuselage behind the aft door; the tail cone blue

logos.description: Royalton's monogram: a large flowing script R in white, edged light blue, on the blue cowling.
Sunwing's small white sun over the fin title's 'wing'.
A small Canadian flag under the cockpit windows.

titles.style: Royalton's script wordmark, large navy flourished lettering over the forward windows from behind the forward door (read off the right side; the left assumed the same).
Small spaced serif under the script's end; on the left side assumed under its aft end, as it follows the word (no open photo of the left).
Small spaced serif under the script's forward end (right side, as photographed).
Small lower case over the windows ahead of the wing.
Thin serif over the windows behind the wing, the first of two lines.
Larger thin serif under the windows, the second line.
Sunwing's wordmark in white up the blue fin, reading upward toward the tip's trailing corner, as on Sunwing's scheme.

notes: Only right-side open photos (2026-03-08 climbing, perspective; 2023-06-02 from ahead): the left side is assumed the same layout. The blue's edge, read off the 2026 photo (crown x 0.74, behind the aft door to the belly at 0.89), matches Sunwing's orange, so WJA/sunwing's measured edge is used. Titles' ends read off the fitted 2026 photo; their heights and baselines only roughly (low): the photo looks up at the climbing jet. The registration and the small titles' exact lettering aren't drawn; the script is set as text (no mark for it).
history: New 2026-11-22. Sunwing painted C-GMXB for Royalton Luxury Resorts (on Commons by June 2023); it flies on for WestJet since Sunwing was folded in (Cancún, 2026-03-08).
